riskBeforeConstruction.typical: System clashes, dimensional errors, and connection issues are typically discovered after materials arrive on site.

technicalDocumentation.label: Technical documentation
technicalDocumentation.typical: Documentation is limited to product data sheets and generic installation guides; execution responsibilities are not documented.

items.question: Is the initial engineering review free?
items.answer: Yes. The first technical review of your project scope, system risks, and execution requirements is provided at no cost.

items.question: How quickly will SIPANEL respond?
items.answer: Initial feedback is typically provided within 1-2 business days after receiving project details.

items.question: Can I contact SIPANEL if the project is still in design phase?
items.answer: Yes. Early-stage consultation helps identify system selection, waterproofing, and coordination risks before they become costly during execution.

items.question: What documents can I submit?
items.answer: Drawings, site photos, or technical specifications in PDF, JPG, PNG, or DWG format. Documents are optional — you can start with a project description only.

items.question: What happens after I submit the request?
items.answer: SIPANEL reviews the submitted information, identifies key engineering risks, and contacts you with initial technical feedback and recommended next steps.

items.question: Does SIPANEL only work on large industrial projects?
items.answer: No. SIPANEL reviews projects of various scales — from single-building roofing to multi-structure industrial facilities.

items.question: Can SIPANEL review an existing leakage or execution problem?
items.answer: Yes. Existing problems including roof leakage, flashing failures, panel damage, and drainage issues can be reviewed for corrective engineering solutions.

items.question: Can international projects be reviewed?
items.answer: Yes. SIPANEL has experience with projects in Iran and neighboring countries and can review international project requirements remotely.
